initial_prompt: Give a one-sentence explanation of quantum entanglement for a bright 12-year-old. Keep it under 30 words.

messages.content: Give a one-sentence explanation of quantum entanglement for a bright 12-year-old. Keep it under 30 words.
Quantum entanglement is when two tiny particles become mysteriously linked so that whatever happens to one instantly affects the other, even if they’re very far apart.
